{{Quote|The city is now on alert. We've ordered a curfew and we'll have all our officers start checking IDs. There are a lot of people here though: could take a while.|Tessus|<ref name="The Isis Coordinates">''[[The Isis Coordinates]]''</ref>}}
[[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] '''Tessus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as a security guard in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Neskroff/Legends|Neskroff]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Isis/Legends|Isis]]. After an [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] team traveled to Neskfroff, a group of Alliance agents warned Tessus of the Imperials' presence in the city and Tessus used a [[com-box]] to alert the city's authorities.
